modules.name: rv32i5

modules.name: hazard_unit

modules.interfaces: input logic clk; input logic rst_n; input logic redirect; input logic halted; input logic id_is_ecall; input logic ifid_valid; input logic [31:0] ifid_instr; input logic id_ex_valid; input logic id_ex_is_load; input logic [4:0] id_ex_rd; output logic halt_pending; output logic stall_load_use; output logic flush_ifid; output logic flush_idex

modules.name: forwarding_unit
modules.description: EX-stage rs1/rs2 forwarding select (EX/MEM over MEM/WB, loads excluded from EX/MEM) and MEM-stage store-data forwarding select.
modules.interfaces: input logic id_ex_valid; input logic [4:0] id_ex_rs1; input logic [4:0] id_ex_rs2; input logic ex_mem_valid; input logic ex_mem_reg_write; input logic [4:0] ex_mem_rd; input logic ex_mem_is_load; input logic [4:0] ex_mem_rs2; input logic ex_mem_is_store; input logic mem_wb_valid; input logic mem_wb_reg_write; input logic [4:0] mem_wb_rd; output logic [1:0] fwd_a; output logic [1:0] fwd_b; output logic store_fwd

modules.name: alu
modules.interfaces: input logic [31:0] a; input logic [31:0] b; input logic [3:0] op; output logic [31:0] y

modules.name: regfile
modules.description: 32x32 architectural register file, x0 hardwired to 0, two combinational read ports with same-cycle write bypass, debug read port and dedicated x10 read port.
modules.interfaces: input logic clk; input logic rst_n; input logic we; input logic [4:0] waddr; input logic [31:0] wdata; input logic [4:0] raddr1; output logic [31:0] rdata1; input logic [4:0] raddr2; output logic [31:0] rdata2; input logic [4:0] dbg_addr; output logic [31:0] dbg_data; output logic [31:0] x10_data

notes: Encoding conventions frozen for all files. alu_op (4 bit): 0=ADD,1=SUB,2=SLL,3=SLT,4=SLTU,5=XOR,6=SRL,7=SRA,8=OR,9=AND. alu_a_sel (2 bit): 0=forwarded rs1, 1=id_ex_pc, 2=32'b0 (LUI). alu_b_sel (2 bit): 0=forwarded rs2, 1=id_ex_imm. LUI uses a_sel=2,b_sel=1,ADD; AUIPC uses a_sel=1,b_sel=1,ADD. branch_f3/mem_f3 carry the raw funct3. fwd_a/fwd_b (2 bit): 00=id_ex_*_data, 01=EX/MEM ex_mem_result, 10=MEM/WB mem_wb_data. fwd_ex_mem_data is ex_stage's own registered ex_mem_result routed back by the top; fwd_mem_wb_data is mem_stage's registered mem_wb_data. store_fwd=1 selects mem_wb_wb_data as MEM-stage store data, else ex_mem_store_data. halt routed to mem_stage is (halted | halt_commit); halt_commit is wb_stage combinational (mem_wb_valid && mem_wb_is_ecall). Redirect priority: in if_stage redirect > stall > (pc_hold/kill); PC update order reset > redirect > halt_pending/halted hold > load-use stall > PC+4. hazard_unit: stall_load_use is asserted only when !redirect && ifid_valid && id_ex_valid && id_ex_is_load && id_ex_rd!=0 && (id_ex_rd==ifid_instr[19:15] || (id_ex_rd==ifid_instr[24:20] && opcode!=0100011)); halt_pending is a register set when id_is_ecall && !redirect and held until reset; flush_ifid = redirect | halt_pending | halted | (id_is_ecall & ~redirect); flush_idex = redirect | halted | halt_pending. Store rs2 uses MEM-stage store-data forwarding instead of a stall. The top drives if_stage.kill from flush_ifid, if_stage.pc_hold from (halt_pending|halted|stall_load_use), id_stage.flush from flush_idex, ex_stage.flush from (halted|halt_commit), mem_stage.halt from (halted|halt_commit). dmem_valid is asserted only as rst_n && !halt && ex_mem_valid && (ex_mem_is_load||ex_mem_is_store); dmem_we only for stores; load data sampled from dmem_rdata at the MEM/WB clock edge and byte/halfword-selected by ex_mem_result[1:0]. ECALL commits only at WB (mem_wb_valid && mem_wb_is_ecall): halted<=1 and exit_code<=x10_value on that edge; reset clears halted and exit_code. Regi
